# `flora` command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_docs.py from the typer app; do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: uv run python scripts/cli_docs.py --write -->

Every command takes `--help`. Most read `flora.yaml` from the current directory (`--config` to
point elsewhere).

## Where the job and the store come from

The job commands (`flora status`, `logs`, `cancel`, `resume`, `report`, `results` and `export`)
take the job id as an optional argument (`--job` for `results` and `export`) and the store as an
optional `--store`:

| | Default | Override |
|---|---|---|
| job id | the config's `project` | the `JOB` argument (`results`, `export`: `--job`) |
| store | `output.sink`, then `flora-local-store/` (1) | `--store URI`, `FLORA_STORE` |
| config | `./flora.yaml` | `--config PATH` |

(1) The config's `output.sink` (`volume://x` is the Modal Volume `x`), then the local store
that `flora run --local` writes, `flora-local-store/` next to `flora.yaml`, when it exists.
Client commands read `modal-volume://`, `s3://` and local stores; `gs://` and `r2://` are not
supported (for R2 or GCS, use `s3://` with their S3 endpoint in `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`).

Fake-models runs (`--fake-models`, and every `--local` run) use the job id `<project>.fake`, so
they never mix with real jobs. With the job id left to its default, a command uses the real run;
when there is none but a fake-models run exists it uses that one and prints one line saying the
results come from stand-in models. When both exist it uses the real one and says the fake one
exists. A job id you pass by name is used exactly as given.

`flora index` writes its summary to `summary.json` next to `flora.yaml`, and `flora plan` reads
it from there when you give no `--index` or `--video-hours`.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | done (or still running: `status`, `run --detach`) |
| 1 | failed |
| 2 | refused, or a usage error (bad config or arguments, job not found, internal error) (1) |
| 3 | completed with some episodes excluded (`completed_with_errors`) |
| 4 | stopped by the budget (`budget_stopped`) |
| 5 | cancelled or stopped (local runs: also interrupted, or the job's lease is held) |

(1) Also `flora export` refusing uncertified or fake-models records without
`--allow-uncertified` / `--allow-fake`.

130 means interrupted with Ctrl-C.

## Commands

### `flora init`

Write a commented flora.yaml to start from.

```
flora init [PATH] [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | `flora.yaml` | Where to write the config. |
| `--template`, `-t` | `balanced_lerobot` | One of: balanced_lerobot, balanced_mp4_dir, exact_lerobot, exact_mp4_dir, rewards_only, local_demo, local_demo_lerobot. |
| `--force` | off | Overwrite an existing file. |
| `--list` | off | List the templates and exit. |

### `flora doctor`

Preflight checks (config, Modal, Hugging Face, store, weights, budget, input). No spend.

```
flora doctor [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml to check. |
| `--json` | off | Print JSON. |

### `flora prepare`

Download and verify the pinned Flora snapshots in your Modal Volume, then build the derived weights the config's preset needs and record their receipts in flora.yaml.

```
flora prepare [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | off | List pinned files and sizes, and the derived weights that would be built, with their estimated cost. Builds nothing. |
| `--json` | off | Machine-readable output (only JSON on stdout). |
| `--reverify` | off | Ignore existing receipts and re-hash every file (catches silent storage corruption). |
| `--only` |  | Pin key to prepare (repeatable). Skips the derived weights. |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml: its preset decides the derived weights, and their receipts are recorded in it (weights.derived). |
| `--skip-derived` | off | Prepare the snapshots only. |
| `--only-derived` | off | Build the derived weights only (snapshots prepared). |
| `--force-derived` | off | Rebuild the derived weights even if their receipts pass. |
| `--show-receipt` | off | Read each derived weight's receipt from the Volume (no container, no build) and print its receipt sha256 and recomputed content digest vs the pin. |

### `flora index`

Index a dataset: per-episode receipts (video probe, envelope, eligibility).

```
flora index [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml |
| `--local` | off | Run in this process instead of on Modal (free; downloads the dataset here). |
| `--job` |  | Job id (default: project). |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store: file:///dir, s3://bucket[/prefix], modal-volume://name[/prefix] (default: from output.sink). |
| `--limit` |  | Index only the first N episodes. |
| `--decode`, `--no-decode` |  | Decode-check the cameras that can be certified against NVIDIA's reference (default: on for preset exact). |
| `--max-episodes-per-unit` | `64` | Episodes per work unit (a source file is never split). |
| `--work` |  | --local: where Hub files are downloaded (default: input.stage_to or ~/.cache/flora-deploy/datasets). |
| `--force`, `--no-force` | --no-force | Re-index episodes that have receipts. |
| `--out` |  | Also write the summary here (default: summary.json next to the config, where `flora plan` reads it). |

### `flora plan`

Show 2-4 run options (cost, wall-clock, GPUs, certification) and optionally pick one.

```
flora plan [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml |
| `--budget` |  | USD cap (default: modal.budget_usd) |
| `--deadline` |  | e.g. 48h, 90m, 2d |
| `--preset` |  | Preset(s) to consider (repeatable; default: every available preset). |
| `--video-hours` |  | Total video hours, instead of the `flora index` summary. |
| `--episodes` |  | Episode count (with --video-hours). |
| `--cameras` |  | Views per episode (default: config). |
| `--index` |  | Workload summary JSON (default: the summary.json `flora index` wrote next to the config). |
| `--max-gpus` |  | GPU cap (default: modal.max_gpus) |
| `--rates` |  | rates.json to use instead of the shipped one. |
| `--live-prices`, `--no-live-prices` | --no-live-prices | Read live prices from your Modal workspace (needs Modal credentials). |
| `--write` |  | Write option N (1-based) into the config. |
| `--json` | off | Print options as JSON. |
| `--check-cache` | off | Price balanced pools whose compile cache is published on flora-cache (needs Modal credentials) with the warm startup row. |
| `--assume-warm` | off | Projection: price every pool's startup warm, as if a compile cache were published. |

### `flora estimate`

Measure per-stage rates on a sample of the dataset (needs a deployed app).

```
flora estimate [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml |
| `--sample` | `20` | Episodes to run for calibration. |
| `--rates` |  | A rates.json (e.g. from an earlier estimate) to show instead. |

### `flora deploy`

Deploy the config's Modal app (one app per config; workers scale from zero).

```
flora deploy [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store seen by containers: modal-volume://name[/path] or s3://bucket[/prefix] (default: output.sink). |
| `--bucket-secret` | `flora-bucket` | Modal Secret holding the bucket credentials. |
| `--receipt` |  | Derived-weight receipt NAME=HASH (repeatable): overrides weights.derived, which `flora prepare` records in flora.yaml. |
| `--allow-uncertified` | off | Deploy even if a stage has no accuracy certificate for this config (its records say certified: false). |
| `--min-containers` | `0` | Warm containers per worker class. |
| `--reconcile-cron` |  | Schedule the reconciler: 'on' (every 10 min) or a cron string. |
| `--determinism` |  | Override pipeline.determinism (exact segcap worker): nvidia \| deterministic. Hashed: it changes the config hash and the app. |
| `--emit` |  | Write the equivalent standalone script here instead of deploying. |
| `--dry-run` | off | Print the plan; do not contact Modal. |
| `--json` | off | Print the plan as JSON. |
| `--fake-models` | off | Test app: fake engines on CPU workers (no GPU, no weights; hashed apart from real outputs). |

### `flora run`

Run a job: on the deployed Modal app (default) or locally with --local --fake-models.

```
flora run [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml |
| `--detach` | off | Modal: start the job and return (watch with `flora status`). |
| `--receipt` |  | Modal: derived-weight receipt NAME=HASH (repeatable); overrides weights.derived in flora.yaml, as for `flora deploy`. |
| `--determinism` |  | Modal: the --determinism the app was deployed with (nvidia \| deterministic). |
| `--allow-uncertified` | off | Modal: as deployed with --allow-uncertified. |
| `--bucket-secret` | `flora-bucket` | Modal: Secret with the bucket credentials (bucket stores). |
| `--poll` | `15.0` | Modal: seconds between status polls. |
| `--local` | off | Run in this process (needs --fake-models). |
| `--fake-models` | off | Deterministic fake engines instead of NVIDIA's models (local, or on Modal: the app `flora deploy --fake-models` deployed). |
| `--inject` |  | Local: faults, KIND:TARGET[xN] (see flora_deploy.local.faults). |
| `--store` |  | Modal: job store URI (default: output.sink). Local: store directory (default: &lt;config dir&gt;/flora-local-store). |
| `--job` |  | Job id (default: project). |
| `--resume` | off | Local: lift a budget stop (Modal: use `flora resume &lt;job&gt;`). |
| `--budget` |  | USD budget override (default: modal.budget_usd). |
| `--sample-data` | off | Local: write a synthetic dataset (as input.format says) to input.path first. |
| `--json` | off | Print the result as JSON. |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | off | Local: every event. |

### `flora status`

Show a job's state, progress, errors, spend vs budget and ETA.

```
flora status [JOB] [OPTIONS]
```

Job and store default from `flora.yaml` ([above](#where-the-job-and-the-store-come-from)).

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `JOB` |  | Job id (default: the config's project; its fake-models run &lt;project&gt;.fake when there is no real one). |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store: modal-volume://name[/path], s3://bucket[/prefix], file:///dir or a directory (default: the config's output.sink, then &lt;config dir&gt;/flora-local-store). |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml (finds the store and Modal environment). |
| `--env` (env `MODAL_ENVIRONMENT`) |  | Modal environment of a modal-volume store. |
| `--json` | off | Print JSON. |

### `flora logs`

Show a job's Modal logs.

```
flora logs [JOB] [OPTIONS]
```

Job and store default from `flora.yaml` ([above](#where-the-job-and-the-store-come-from)).

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `JOB` |  | Job id (default: the config's project; its fake-models run &lt;project&gt;.fake when there is no real one). |
| `--kind` |  | orchestrator, or a worker kind (segment, caption, segcap, reward.terminal, ...). |
| `--follow`, `-f` | off | Stream new lines. |
| `--tail`, `-n` | `100` | Lines per call (not with -f). |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store: modal-volume://name[/path], s3://bucket[/prefix], file:///dir or a directory (default: the config's output.sink, then &lt;config dir&gt;/flora-local-store). |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml (finds the store and Modal environment). |
| `--env` (env `MODAL_ENVIRONMENT`) |  | Modal environment of a modal-volume store. |

### `flora cancel`

Cancel a job (its in-flight calls are cancelled; it cannot be resumed).

```
flora cancel [JOB] [OPTIONS]
```

Job and store default from `flora.yaml` ([above](#where-the-job-and-the-store-come-from)).

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `JOB` |  | Job id (default: the config's project; its fake-models run &lt;project&gt;.fake when there is no real one). |
| `--reason` | `operator cancel` | Recorded with the cancel. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | off | Do not ask for confirmation. |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store: modal-volume://name[/path], s3://bucket[/prefix], file:///dir or a directory (default: the config's output.sink, then &lt;config dir&gt;/flora-local-store). |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml (finds the store and Modal environment). |
| `--env` (env `MODAL_ENVIRONMENT`) |  | Modal environment of a modal-volume store. |

### `flora resume`

Resume a budget-stopped job or restart a dead orchestrator.

```
flora resume [JOB] [OPTIONS]
```

Job and store default from `flora.yaml` ([above](#where-the-job-and-the-store-come-from)).

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `JOB` |  | Job id (default: the config's project; its fake-models run &lt;project&gt;.fake when there is no real one). |
| `--budget-usd` |  | New job budget in USD (not below the spend so far). |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store: modal-volume://name[/path], s3://bucket[/prefix], file:///dir or a directory (default: the config's output.sink, then &lt;config dir&gt;/flora-local-store). |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml (finds the store and Modal environment). |
| `--env` (env `MODAL_ENVIRONMENT`) |  | Modal environment of a modal-volume store. |

Spend by kind/container, $/video-hour, errors, certification and output locations.

flora report [JOB] [OPTIONS]

Job and store default from `flora.yaml` ([above](#where-the-job-and-the-store-come-from)).

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `JOB` |  | Job id (default: the config's project; its fake-models run &lt;project&gt;.fake when there is no real one). |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store: modal-volume://name[/path], s3://bucket[/prefix], file:///dir or a directory (default: the config's output.sink, then &lt;config dir&gt;/flora-local-store). |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml (finds the store and Modal environment). |
| `--env` (env `MODAL_ENVIRONMENT`) |  | Modal environment of a modal-volume store. |
| `--json` | off | Print JSON. |

### `flora results`

Read a composed stage's records (job and store default from flora.yaml).

```
flora results [STAGE] [OPTIONS]
```

Job and store default from `flora.yaml` ([above](#where-the-job-and-the-store-come-from)).

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `STAGE` |  | segment \| caption \| reward.terminal \| reward.dense \| reward.rubric |
| `--job` |  | Job id (default: the config's project; its fake-models run &lt;project&gt;.fake when there is no real one). |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store: file:///dir (or a path), s3://bucket[/prefix], modal-volume://name (default: the config's output.sink, then &lt;config dir&gt;/flora-local-store). |
| `--format` | `table` | jsonl \| parquet \| table |
| `--out` |  | Write to this file. |
| `--config-hash` |  | Config hash (default: the job manifest's). |
| `--limit` | `50` | Rows shown by --format table. |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml (finds the store and Modal environment). |
| `--env` (env `MODAL_ENVIRONMENT`) |  | Modal environment of a modal-volume store. |

### `flora compose`

Compose a job's parts into per-stage JSONL + Parquet and a summary.json.

```
flora compose [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--job` | required | Job id. |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) | required | State-of-record store: file:///dir (or a path), s3://bucket[/prefix], modal-volume://name. |
| `--config-hash` |  | Config hash (default: the job manifest's). |
| `--partial` | off | Compose what exists even if the job is not complete. |
| `--max-error-rate` | `0.1` | Excluded share of a stage above which the job is completed_with_errors. |

### `flora certify`

Certify a balanced stack against exact, within NVIDIA's own run-to-run noise.

```
flora certify [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--exact` | required | Records of the exact reference run, JSONL. |
| `--balanced` | required | Candidate records on the same episodes, JSONL. |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | The candidate run's flora.yaml (preset, pools, modes). |
| `--noise` |  | The exact run repeated on a subset of its episodes, JSONL: the noise floor. |
| `--witness` |  | Candidate records from one container forced cold (FLORA_COMPILE_CACHE=off), JSONL: the cold witness, checked like the candidate (docs/certification.md). |
| `--l0` |  | balanced_lab result JSON (the in-engine input and dt_bias checks), repeatable (one per model kind). |
| `--stage` |  | Stage(s) to certify (default: every certifiable stage in the candidate records). |
| `--gpu` |  | GPU type certified (default: the config's pool GPU for the stage). |
| `--tolerance` | `1.5` | Allowed multiple of the noise floor, in [1, 2]. |
| `--min-samples` | `10` | Episodes needed per (stage, embodiment pool); at least 10. |
| `--min-noise-samples` | `5` | Noise-run episodes per stage; at least 5. |
| `--slack` |  | Absolute slack METRIC=VALUE added to the threshold (repeatable; default 0; at most the metric's noise floor). |
| `--derived-content` |  | Derived-weight content digest NAME=SHA256 (its pinned content digest) of the weights the candidate ran with (repeatable; required for segment/caption). |
| `--similarity` |  | Optional caption text-similarity hook module:function -&gt; [0,1] (off by default). |
| `--out-dir` |  | Where to write certificates (default: the package registry; a failed one is written only with --out-dir). |
| `--json` | off | Print the certificates as JSON. |
| `--generated-at` |  | Certificate time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (default: now). Pass the run's own time to make re-certifying the same records reproduce the same certificate id. |

### `flora version`

Print the framework version.

```
flora version
```

### `flora export`

Write a job's labels into a copy of its LeRobot dataset (the source is never modified).

```
flora export [OPTIONS]
```

Job and store default from `flora.yaml` ([above](#where-the-job-and-the-store-come-from)).

| Argument / option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--out` | required | New directory for the labeled copy. |
| `--job` |  | Job id (default: the config's project; its fake-models run when there is no real one). |
| `--store` (env `FLORA_STORE`) |  | Job store: file:///dir (or a path), s3://bucket[/prefix], modal-volume://name (default: the config's output.sink, then &lt;config dir&gt;/flora-local-store). |
| `--config`, `-c` | `flora.yaml` | flora.yaml (finds the store and Modal environment). |
| `--env` (env `MODAL_ENVIRONMENT`) |  | Modal environment of a modal-volume store. |
| `--to` | `lerobot` | Target format (lerobot). |
| `--stages` |  | Stages to export (repeat or comma-separate): segment, caption, reward.terminal, reward.dense. Default: every composed one. |
| `--source` |  | Local copy of the source dataset (default: the job's dataset; a Hub dataset is fetched at its pinned revision, meta/ and data/ only). |
| `--include-videos` | off | Copy the videos too (default: reference the source). |
| `--allow-uncertified` | off | Export uncertified records (recorded in the metadata). |
| `--allow-fake` | off | Export fake-model records (recorded in the metadata). |
| `--push-to-hub` |  | Upload the export to this dataset repo (user/repo). |
| `--public` | off | With --push-to-hub: make the repo public (default private). |
| `--config-hash` |  | Config hash (default: the job manifest's). |
